# xterm.js

Bundled with Task Proxy to draw script output in the Terminal Manager. These are the published, already minified builds, copied unchanged, so do not edit or re-minify them.

| File | Package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` | 6.0.0 |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` | 0.11.0 |

Both are MIT licensed by the xterm.js authors (see `LICENSE`). To update, copy `lib/xterm.js` and `css/xterm.css` from `@xterm/xterm`, and `lib/addon-fit.js` from `@xterm/addon-fit`, then update this table.
